hook.name: EnhancedFeeDistributionHookV2
hook.description: Captures swap fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta (pool must have fee=0), buffers them per token, and converts to a single configured reward token via a nested V4 pool swap when a buffer threshold is met. Rewards are distributed to in-range liquidity providers using ERC-6909 accounting and tick-based reward growth tracking, with claims settled through PositionManager NFT ownership.
